move: pill words drift weightless, each squashes, springs and bounces once
how: Five pill-shaped words and four faint dots sit on a lavender square. Every word drifts on a seeded sine in x, y and rotation (fromTo with yoyo, half the duration each way, sine.inOut) so the field is always slowly turning and returns to its start at D. Staggered 0.5s apart from 0.05D, each word gets a tap: scaleX 1.25 / scaleY 0.75 over 0.12s (power2.in), then elastic.out(1.1,0.35) back to 1 over 0.9s while y jumps -70 (power2.out, 0.28s) and drops back with bounce.out over 0.5s. Dots bob on the same sine yoyo.
adapt: Change the five word strings, pill colours and positions, and the seed passed to fx.rng; keep the 0.12s squash / 0.9s elastic / 0.5s bounce timings and the 0.5s stagger, which read as the weightless tap.
port: mount(el, shot) appends the .word pills and .dot divs with the shot's strings and colours; animate(el, shot, D) returns the same timeline with drifts as D/2 yoyo tweens and taps at 0.05D + i*0.17D. Scope querySelectorAll('.word') to el; the relative y '-=70' / '+=70' tweens must stay after the drift tween in build order.
caveats: relative y tweens (-=70/+=70) stack on the sine drift tween on the same property; scrubbing backwards can leave words offset
last word's elastic settle ends at 3.17s, past D=3, so the loop closes only approximately
positions are absolute pixels for a 1080x1080 stage
